title: A Big Week For Markets
text:
A Big Week For Markets

Will Denyer

Gavekal Research | 16 Nov 2026

This will be an eventful week for markets. On Tuesday, Nvidia will report its third-quarter earnings, diverting attention—even if only briefly—from former CEO Jensen Huang’s amorous affairs to what will be seen as an important healthcheck for the state of the AI capex boom. Then on Wednesday, Anthropic will price its IPO, before its shares begin trading Thursday. Meanwhile, after Friday’s air traffic control system failure grounded commercial flights throughout the US, President Donald Trump is calling on Congress to greenlight funds for an early upgrade, even as he is demanding immediate approval for an additional US$350bn in military spending.All this adds up to a lot of demand for capital, at a time when—as BlackRock CEO Larry Fink put it in October—the US is “seeing genuine shortages of capital,” and when the US Federal Reserve is poised to tighten monetary policy, with the futures market pricing in a certain rate hike in December and another probable increase in January. This is an ugly combination for bond markets, and helps explain why 10-year US treasury yields have risen 32bp from their November 5 low to trade at 5.14% early Monday.
